say:1:1641116001:1.text: I'm not here on a leisure stroll. My visit to Holt Street concerns matters of great significance.
say:1:1641116001:1.source_cn: 我并非闲逛，来到霍尔特商业街是为了处理一些价值更高的事物。
say:1:1641116001:1.male: I'm not here on a leisure stroll. My visit to Holt Street concerns matters of great significance.
say:1:1641116001:1.female: I'm not here on a leisure stroll. My visit to Holt Street concerns matters of great significance.

choice_prompt:2:1641116001.text: I'm not here on a leisure stroll. My visit to Holt Street concerns matters of great significance.
choice_prompt:2:1641116001.source_cn: 我并非闲逛，来到霍尔特商业街是为了处理一些价值更高的事物。
choice_prompt:2:1641116001.male: I'm not here on a leisure stroll. My visit to Holt Street concerns matters of great significance.
choice_prompt:2:1641116001.female: I'm not here on a leisure stroll. My visit to Holt Street concerns matters of great significance.

say:3:1641116002:1.text: I'll take that blessing. Though truth be told, I wouldn't mind pausing here a moment—especially if the conversation turns out worthwhile.
say:3:1641116002:1.source_cn: 噢，你的关心我收下了……不过我并不介意在此停留片刻，和...
say:3:1641116002:1.male: I'll take that blessing. Though truth be told, I wouldn't mind pausing here a moment—especially if the conversation turns out worthwhile.
say:3:1641116002:1.female: I'll take that blessing. Though truth be told, I wouldn't mind pausing here a moment—especially if the conversation turns out worthwhile.

say:4:1641116005:1.text: Just look around. The street's alive—people shouting over each other, vendors pushing their wares like their lives depend on it.
say:4:1641116005:1.source_cn: 看看这条街，人声鼎沸，叫卖声此起彼伏。
say:4:1641116005:1.male: Just look around. The street's alive—people shouting over each other, vendors pushing their wares like their lives depend on it.
say:4:1641116005:1.female: Just look around. The street's alive—people shouting over each other, vendors pushing their wares like their lives depend on it.

say:5:1641116006:1.text: They trade, earn, restock, and repeat—caught in an endless loop. It's exhausting to watch.
say:5:1641116006:1.source_cn: 他们急于把自己的货物出手，然后用这些钱换取更多货物……...
say:5:1641116006:1.male: They trade, earn, restock, and repeat—caught in an endless loop. It's exhausting to watch.
say:5:1641116006:1.female: They trade, earn, restock, and repeat—caught in an endless loop. It's exhausting to watch.

say:6:1641116007:1.text: I used to think that was the merchant's way. But over time, I learned: It's not brawn that wins in trade. It's strategy.
say:6:1641116007:1.source_cn: 我曾也认为这就是“商人之道”，不过我慢慢开始发现，商人...
say:6:1641116007:1.male: I used to think that was the merchant's way. But over time, I learned: It's not brawn that wins in trade. It's strategy.
say:6:1641116007:1.female: I used to think that was the merchant's way. But over time, I learned: It's not brawn that wins in trade. It's strategy.

choice_prompt:7:1641116007.text: I used to think that was the merchant's way. But over time, I learned: It's not brawn that wins in trade. It's strategy.
choice_prompt:7:1641116007.source_cn: 我曾也认为这就是“商人之道”，不过我慢慢开始发现，商人的竞争在于头脑，而并非体力。
choice_prompt:7:1641116007.male: I used to think that was the merchant's way. But over time, I learned: It's not brawn that wins in trade. It's strategy.
choice_prompt:7:1641116007.female: I used to think that was the merchant's way. But over time, I learned: It's not brawn that wins in trade. It's strategy.

say:8:1641116008:1.text: Of course. I've never denied that the little stalls give the place its charm... or that they've helped the Mithril Consortium thrive.
say:8:1641116008:1.source_cn: 当然，我从未否认，这些小商贩也成就了秘银商会的繁荣。
say:8:1641116008:1.male: Of course. I've never denied that the little stalls give the place its charm... or that they've helped the Mithril Consortium thrive.
say:8:1641116008:1.female: Of course. I've never denied that the little stalls give the place its charm... or that they've helped the Mithril Consortium thrive.

say:9:1641116009:1.text: But the glue that holds the consortium together? That comes from above.
say:9:1641116009:1.source_cn: 但秘银商会的凝聚力源于上层。
say:9:1641116009:1.male: But the glue that holds the consortium together? That comes from above.
say:9:1641116009:1.female: But the glue that holds the consortium together? That comes from above.

say:10:1641116010:1.text: Strategy at the top determines what gets produced at the bottom. And the more that gets produced, the more people want to stay.
say:10:1641116010:1.source_cn: 上层思维决定下层产出，而产出的多少，决定了多少人愿意留下。
say:10:1641116010:1.male: Strategy at the top determines what gets produced at the bottom. And the more that gets produced, the more people want to stay.
say:10:1641116010:1.female: Strategy at the top determines what gets produced at the bottom. And the more that gets produced, the more people want to stay.

say:11:1641116011:1.text: I don't produce goods or sell them. I find people who make things happen, then build bridges between them.
say:11:1641116011:1.source_cn: 我真正擅长的，是寻找能创造价值的人，让合作发生。
say:11:1641116011:1.male: I don't produce goods or sell them. I find people who make things happen, then build bridges between them.
say:11:1641116011:1.female: I don't produce goods or sell them. I find people who make things happen, then build bridges between them.

say:12:1641116012:1.text: Goods don't last, ledgers can burn, and even mines run dry.
say:12:1641116012:1.source_cn: 商品会褪色，账本会焚毁，矿藏会枯竭。
say:12:1641116012:1.male: Goods don't last, ledgers can burn, and even mines run dry.
say:12:1641116012:1.female: Goods don't last, ledgers can burn, and mines run dry...

say:13:1641116013:1.text: But the right person? They carry value forward, long after the rest is gone.
say:13:1641116013:1.male: But the right person? They carry value forward, long after the rest is gone.
say:13:1641116013:1.female: But the right person? They carry value forward, long after the rest is gone.

say:14:1641116014:1.text: That, to me, is what true win-win partnership looks like.
say:14:1641116014:1.source_cn: 这，才是我所谓的“合作共赢”。
say:14:1641116014:1.male: That, to me, is what true win-win partnership looks like.
say:14:1641116014:1.female: That, to me, is what true win-win partnership looks like.

choice:7:0:1.text: It's those vendors who give this street its heartbeat.
choice:7:0:1.source_cn: 反而是这些商贩构建了商业街
choice:7:0:1.male: It's those vendors who give this street its heartbeat.
choice:7:0:1.female: It's those vendors who give this street its heartbeat.

choice:7:1:2.text: So what's your business creed, then?
choice:7:1:2.male: So what's your business creed, then?
choice:7:1:2.female: So what's your business creed, then?

choice:2:0:1.text: Well then... I hope it all goes well for you.
choice:2:0:1.male: Well then... I hope it all goes well for you.
choice:2:0:1.female: Well then... I hope it all goes well for you.

say:16:1641116003:1.text: Hmm... I suppose that depends on whether this chat gives me any new ideas.
say:16:1641116003:1.source_cn: 进展？也许顺利与否，取决于我们此次聊天的喻快程度。
say:16:1641116003:1.male: Hmm... I suppose that depends on whether this chat gives me any new ideas.
say:16:1641116003:1.female: Hmm... I suppose that depends on whether this chat gives me any new ideas.

say:17:1641116004:1.text: For me, value is about insight, not the outcome.
say:17:1641116004:1.source_cn: 毕竟我重视的是价值更高，而并非事物本身。
say:17:1641116004:1.male: For me, value is about insight, not the outcome.
say:17:1641116004:1.female: For me, value is about insight, not the outcome.

choice:2:1:2.text: So, how's your grand venture coming along?
choice:2:1:2.male: So, how's your grand venture coming along?
choice:2:1:2.female: So, how's your grand venture coming along?
